cases.name: provider-data-flow
cases.prompt: Review a provider adapter diff that sends document chunks to a remote model.
cases.expected_behavior: Map assets, destination, consent boundary, logs, schema validation, and not-reviewed surfaces; findings include severity and confidence.

cases.name: tauri-privilege
cases.prompt: Review a new Tauri command that opens paths from TypeScript.
cases.expected_behavior: Check command scope, Rust-side validation, workspace boundary enforcement, permission files, and absolute-path logging.

cases.name: dependency-diff
cases.prompt: Review a parser dependency update and lockfile diff.
cases.expected_behavior: Review changelog, transitive native/network behavior, license impact, parser attack surface, and validation coverage.
